analysis_scope: Post-hoc descriptive filtering of the existing run, not a contention-free rerun or a replacement cost ledger.

method.training_start: validation.updated_unix - validation.epoch_wall_seconds, anchored to rank 0 timer after any epoch-start mechanism probe
method.training_end: maximum original epoch JSON file mtime across six ranks, including telemetry write
method.overlap_rule: start < fins_end and training_end > fins_start; remove the entire epoch
method.source_digest_rule: For each variant, concatenate raw bytes in epoch order 1..50: validation/epoch-NNN.json, then epochs/rank-R-epoch-NNN.json for ranks 0..5. SHA256 of this byte stream; original file count 350.
method.matched_comparison: Apply the BN64 included epoch IDs unchanged to BASE and DW; no removal by duration, loss or accuracy.
method.main_metric: For each epoch, max across ranks of (step_seconds + data_wait_seconds), then describe the selected epochs.
method.step_metric: Per-epoch arithmetic mean of six rank step_seconds, compatible with section 6.2.
method.fit_metric: Rank-0 epoch timer through routine validation and save/telemetry, before periodic independent standard evaluation.
method.warmup_sensitivity: In a separately labelled view remove epochs 1..3 from the same included set.

limitations: The selection excludes only known logged FinsSim task windows, not all possible interference or lingering effects.
Timestamp reconstruction and filesystem mtime introduce small boundary uncertainty; expanding known windows by one second does not change selection.
Statistics across epochs are descriptive, not independent multi-seed estimates or confidence intervals.
Do not use the filtered average to rewrite full-run GPU-hours, AP or preregistered retained status.
Training loop timing is not pure GPU compute time and does not include periodic/final standard evaluation or process startup.
